title: codonoboea humilis
intro: Codonoboea humilis, commonly known as the "Malaysian Cat's Claw", is a type of flowering plant native to Southeast Asia. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Codonoboea humilis include antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant effects, making it a potential treatment for conditions like malaria and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
